       COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field','handled the ball','timed out','hit the ball twice') THEN 1 END) AS wickets
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season = '2019'
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.bowler_id
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;
